title: Difficulty Figuring Out Vehicle Features
summary: This topic centers on owners struggling to figure out vehicle technology, controls, updates, or repair-related processes, with many fragments lacking clear sentiment beyond describing confusion or delay.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe the vehicle technology as confusing, overwhelming, and not easy to understand.

mixed.summary: The mixed review notes that the technology is hard to figure out because good explanatory resources are lacking.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined, so the emotional direction of this topic is often unclear.
